gate: Hash frozen before the holdout. Official engine 1.32.7, paired against unmodified cha22 on identical opponents/seeds/seats, both seats. Gate: total paired score >= +6, score against cha22 (mirror) >= 70%, no opponent with a paired delta below -2.0, no reported errors/fallbacks, every callback < 1000 ms. The panel spans the post-lock top (cha22, haideptry v7, Shepherd's Ledger), the pre-lock top ten and the low-band families the forum flags for the climb (a1-t31, hack, utils-v1/V43, shop-router v7). f13x_c22_br also plays the panel for comparison only. Then the Kaggle kernel on four fresh seeds (total > 0, no opponent below the control). Registered before the run.
